headline: University of Arizona newly confirmed restricted: ISS suspended CPT requests not required for a student's program of study, effective 24 Aug, citing SEVP guidance; whether already-authorised CPT survives is not stated. Tripwires unchanged; Davidson, MIT, Skidmore and the University of South Florida remain the only schools confirmed to have interrupted already-granted CPT.

tripwires.name: DHS SEVIS Help Hub CPT page
tripwires.detail: Direct fetch succeeded again 3 Oct 18:14 UTC (4 Oct 02:14 HKT). Page unchanged, still "Last Updated: August 24, 2026," same BCM 2608-01/2608-02 references; cancellation section still only states a DSO can cancel CPT before its start date and, after the start date, can only edit the authorisation to shorten the end date — not cancel it outright. No change to the page itself.

tripwires.name: Tufts I-Center CPT page
tripwires.detail: Direct fetch succeeded again 3 Oct 18:14 UTC — the "due to recent updates to guidelines, the I-Center is unable to process CPT requests for non-required internships at this time" sentence is still present, unchanged; still nothing either way about students who already hold CPT authorisation. No change detected.

tripwires.name: Federal Register rulemaking on CPT
tripwires.detail: Checked 3 Oct 18:14 UTC — no CPT-specific NPRM published, underlying CPT regulation (8 CFR 214.2(f)(10)(i)) not amended; DHS's own CPT-guidance tripwire page still says SEVP 'plans to release draft guidance' clarifying prior CPT documents, no date given. CPT remains guidance (12/24 Aug broadcast messages), not a rule.

tripwires.name: Retroactive cancellation spreading
tripwires.detail: Still tripped, re-checked 3 Oct 18:14 UTC — no new cancellation found this run. TRIPPED 1 Oct — University of South Florida confirmed via its own student newspaper, The Oracle (29 Sept): OIS revoked a master's student's CPT a week after she began an approved BayCare internship (authorised 12 Aug, started working 24 Aug), citing the internship was not required for her degree. First new school to join Davidson, MIT and Skidmore in interrupting already-granted CPT.

tiers.label: Already-approved CPT stopped or withdrawn
tiers.sub: The most severe response: students who already held an authorisation were told to stop work, or had it withdrawn.

context: No CPT-specific litigation. No third broadcast message. DHS's stated position: 'nothing about these regulations has changed.' ICE is auditing schools, with SEVP decertification as the stated risk. Immigration attorneys flag a retroactive-scrutiny risk — past CPT revisited at the OPT, STEM-OPT or H-1B stage. The common institutional reading of the new standard: integral to the curriculum, required of all students in the programme for degree completion, a documented cooperative agreement with the employer, and DSO authorisation before training begins.
